trace.retrieval_query: Do school rules still apply if I violate them during OJT or an off-campus competition?

answer: Yes, school rules still apply if you violate them during OJT or an off-campus competition. Violations committed outside University premises are treated as if committed within the University when you are representing the University at conferences, conventions, competitions, presentations, OJT, or the Student Internship Program (SIP).
